title: Exclusive Québec City & Montmorency Falls ID.BUZZ
blurb:
Explore Québec City from a local's viewpoint in a comfortable Volkswagen ID. Buzz on this private tour designed for 2 to 5 guests. Start your day at Place Royale with a delightful coffee and croissant at Smith Café, then wander through the enchanting streets of Petit-Champlain. Discover the architectural beauty along Grande Allée and the political significance of the Parliament Building, before visiting the historic Plains of Abraham. Enjoy the artistic charm of Montcalm and the vibrant energy of Limoilou. Cap off your journey at the breathtaking Montmorency Falls, with complimentary hotel pickup and flexible drop-off included.

- Private tour for 2 to 5 guests for a personalized experience
- Complimentary hotel pickup and flexible drop-off options
- Enjoy a coffee and croissant at Smith Café to start your day
- Visit local neighborhoods, historic sites, and Montmorency Falls
